The exact identity is refreshEnergy=heatBathEnergy+nonnegative remainder, proved by conditional disintegration under the constructed ground law. No density-ratio bound, small-coupling hypothesis or global mixing premise enters this local comparison. Block refresh is an average over true block rotations; on singleton blocks it is exactly the previously defined physical link-response energy averaged over normalized SU(2) Haar rotations. Summing local comparisons gives a collective conditional-variance lower bound. If the actual ground law has variance factorization constant A on continuous physical sources, the original physical transfer satisfies k*Var_pi(P^k f)<=A*sum_(j<k) E_Haar(P^(j+1) f). With a one-step upper coefficient kappa for that same Haar-averaged energy, contraction is A*kappa/(k+A*kappa). A crude upper coefficient N_links*(exp(8*beta)-1)^2 is proved without a mixing premise. Neither the required ground-law factorization nor uniform physical-scale control of A*kappa/k is proved. The earlier finite-family signed-Gram bound is not automatically a uniform bound for this Haar-indexed family. All twelve Clay obligations remain open.

proof.actual_block_identity: At each actual exterior r, take X from the true conditional ground law and Y from inside Haar. The cross-square equals Var_conditional(f)+E_Haar(E_conditional f-f(Y))^2. Integrate against the actual retained marginal to obtain refreshEnergy=heatBathEnergy+nonnegative remainder.
proof.local_lower: heatBathEnergy(B,f)<=refreshEnergy(B,f), with constant one for every beta>=0 and finite block B, including arbitrary correlated ground laws constructed in the repository. Haar refresh is not asserted stationary for pi.
proof.actual_rotations: Right invariance of inside Haar identifies refresh with averaged left block rotations. For B={e}, the energy is exactly integral_Q responseEnergy(e,q,f) dHaar(q).
proof.collective_lower: Sum_e heatBathEnergy({e},f)<=E_Haar(f), where E_Haar sums the Haar-averaged response over all spatial links.
proof.physical_slab_lower: Assuming Var_pi(F)<=A*sum_e heatBathEnergy({e},F) for every continuous physical F, monotone transfer variance and preservation of gauge invariance give k*Var_pi(P^k f)<=A*sum_(j<k) E_Haar(P^(j+1) f). The generic whole-slab lower premise is thus discharged from a specific static ground-law factorization premise.
proof.upper: The actual original-transfer response inequality, norm(q-1)<=2, and Haar integration prove E_Haar(Pf)<=N_links*(exp(8*beta)-1)^2*(Var_pi(f)-Var_pi(Pf)). This is a finite-cutoff bound with explicit extensive and weak-coupling costs.
proof.contraction: For any improved upper coefficient kappa valid for this same Haar energy on physical sources, Var_pi(P^k f)<=A*kappa/(k+A*kappa)*Var_pi(f), k>0. A second theorem instantiates kappa with the proved crude coefficient, leaving only static ground-law factorization as its additional analytic premise.
